stories.title: Piccadilly line services halted for 24-hour strike
stories.summary: The walkout began at midday with normal service not expected to return to normal until Saturday evening.

stories.title: Teacher misses sentencing for indecent assault on pupils
stories.summary: Police are searching for Sally-Anne Bowen after a judge issued a warrant for not appearing at court.

stories.title: Train attacker 'not intent on cold-blooded murder'
stories.summary: Anthony Williams denies 14 counts of attempted murder - 10 of which were on a moving train.

stories.title: Met assesses BBC's findings on predatory detective
stories.summary: Sir Mark Rowley is reviewing whether to investigate after Panorama's documentary on Warren Arter.

stories.title: Northern line upgrades give green light to colour blind drivers
stories.summary: The Northern line becomes second Tube line accessible to drivers with colour blindness.

stories.title: Met Police trial facial recognition tech on phones
stories.summary: Met officers can check people’s faces against a database of around one million custody images.

stories.title: Police stop and search in spotlight at youth event
stories.summary: Hundreds of young people attend a summit as part of plans to overhaul the tactic of stop and search.

stories.title: London ambulance declares critical incident after 999 call surge
stories.summary: LAS declares critical incident after more than 7,000 calls are made for three consecutive days.

stories.title: Hundreds still homeless after being evacuated from 'unsafe' flats
stories.summary: Investigations continue after the Caxton Works development was declared "at risk of sudden collapse".

stories.title: How Met failed to stop rape-unit detective who abused women
stories.summary: Warren Arter used his position - running a team investigating sexual assaults - to target women.

stories.title: What to do with your fridge if it needs dumping
stories.summary: In London, a number of councils are no longer accepting waste collections of fridges and freezers.

stories.title: How a broken London bridge has split a community
stories.summary: Redbridge Council says Broadmead Road Bridge cannot be fixed without government help.
